vuln_statements.explanation: This DMA memory cleanup operation in the send_error error handling path is vulnerable. When combined with subsequent kfree() calls in dma_alloc_error path, this creates potential for double-free or use-after-free vulnerabilities if the same memory is freed through multiple error paths without proper state tracking.

The kfree() call in dma_alloc_error path may interact dangerously with the preceding dma_free_coherent() call. Without proper validation of whether memory was already freed, this can lead to double-free vulnerabilities in the virtchnl transaction buffer management.
